analysis.title: Uber Technologies Inc. (UBER): Q3'26 Earnings First Take
key_insights: GS expects a muted/neutral initial reaction to Uber's Q3'26 report. Gross Bookings and non-GAAP EPS came in roughly in line with GS/Street estimates and within prior guidance.
Q4'26 guidance for Gross Bookings and non-GAAP EPS was in line with GS estimates. There was no positive or negative surprise versus GS/Street, apart from solid Freight operating performance.
Management remains focused on commercializing the autonomous vehicle (AV) layer. GS says terminal value risk will likely stay a long-standing debate among investors.
Management framed its hybrid network thesis with a subtle shift toward concentrating AV capital behind top-performing partners.
Mobility Gross Bookings, especially in International markets, were hurt by supply constraints, some driver incentives and further refinement of product-led strategies.
Delivery was very strong, with Gross Bookings +23% YoY and Operating Income +30% YoY. Management is shifting toward digesting recent M&A and executing on the secular growth opportunity.
GS expects the earnings call to focus on consumer spending habits, AV proof points, Delivery growth and margin contribution, and the balance between growth investment and capital allocation.

market_movers.rationale: GS reiterates Buy with a $110 12-month target after an in-line Q3'26 print. The target implies 65.2% upside from the $66.60 close on 3 Nov 2026.

earnings_insights: Q3'26 reported (released 11/4): Gross Bookings $59.82bn vs GSe $60.06bn and Street (FactSet) $59.83bn. Mobility $29.51bn, Delivery $28.54bn.
Q3'26 reported total revenue $14.77bn vs GSe $14.58bn and Street $14.67bn. Mobility $7.52bn, Delivery $5.49bn, Freight $1.76bn (the report prints '$1.76n').
Q3'26 reported Adj. EBITDA $2.96bn vs GSe $2.90bn and Street $2.92bn. Reported non-GAAP EPS $0.88 vs GSe and Street $0.86.
Q4'26 company guidance (forecast): total bookings $63.25-65.25bn vs GSe $65.08bn and Street $64.26bn. Non-GAAP EPS $0.95-0.99 vs GSe $0.98 and Street $0.97.

GS estimates (forecast): Q3'26E EPS $0.96 as shown in the quarterly table, Q4'26E $1.10, Q1'27E $1.06. FY26E EPS is $3.34, FY27E $4.79 and FY28E $6.21. These table figures are on a different basis from the $0.88 non-GAAP print and the $0.98 non-GAAP Q4 estimate.
risk_factors: Slower Mobility growth due to demand elasticity, maturation and competition from Autonomous Vehicles.
Regulatory environment around driver classification (compensation, benefits), merchant commission caps and ESG.
Competitive forces in both Mobility and Delivery, including local commerce and logistics.
Normalization of consumer discretionary spend habits within Delivery.
Volatility from the global macro environment and investor risk appetite for growth stocks.
